evidence: Removes Boost.Test dependency and packaging across CMake, depends (depends/packages/boost.mk), Guix (contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh), and vcpkg.
rationale: Removes external dependency overhead and workarounds in Guix and depends by eliminating Boost.Test from the build system. The changes eliminate build-system maintenance friction without addressing an urgent build failure or release blocker.
